# Wafer_Scale_Memristor_Integration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The co-design and fabrication of memristor-based components directly on wafer-scale substrates, combined with topological interconnect patterns for massive parallelism. Critical for achieving the density and energy efficiency required for TCC/iNEST systems, bridging the gap between traditional CMOS and emerging neuromorphic hardware.
